responsibility: Declaratively defines the C-family-specific target hooks available to back ends, such as handling C options, string-object support for Objective-C/C/C++, preincluded headers, and target-specific implicit extern "C" decisions. GCC’s hook-generation machinery consumes this file to create the gcc_targetcm structure and associated accessors/documentation, separating target extension points from their target implementations.
same_name_distinction: Hook-definition metadata file for C-family target customization: unlike c-target.h, it does not declare the final hook struct directly, but lists the DEFHOOK entries and documentation from which the generated gcc_targetcm layout and accessors are produced.
